newsitem.title: UK: CMG shares jump as profits stack up.
newsitem.headline: CMG shares jump as profits stack up.

text.p: Shares in Anglo-Dutch computer services company CMG jumped over seven percent on Monday after a strong set of annual results and promises of further growth to come.
CMG shares were up 82-1/2 pence to 1252-1/2 pence by 0925 GMT in London.
The company, which is quoted in London and Amsterdam, said 1996 net profits were up 37 percent to 17.1 million stg and paid a final dividend of four pence per share, up from 3.2 pence previously.
"The gains are purely on the results, they are a very good set of figures," said one trader.
CMG also said that it expected to achieve a "healthy" profit growth in 1997.
"The figures were good and now we should see some support around these share price levels," the trader said.
